_comment: How enemies pick their intent. Every candidate action gets a score; the highest wins. Each weight is base + sum of (lean x personality value), where a personality value runs from -1 (aggressive, solitary, reactive) to +1 (defensive, supportive, methodical). Every number here is a first guess. TODO(decision: d-personality-map).

energy_cost._doc: subtracted per energy point the action spends

kill._doc: added when the action would down its target

heal._doc: per point of hp restored to an ally

retaliate._doc: added for targeting the opponent that acted most recently

focus._doc: per share of hp the target has already lost, 0 to 1

wait._doc: a wait for an unaffordable skill scores this share of using it now

skill_roles._doc: Skills that are not plain attacks. A heal skill restores (attack x power_percent / 100) hp to one living ally, capped at what the ally lost.
